messages:
harper: heads-up - ran into a parity bug between REST and node-sdk for the reranker. REST honors ?top_k=5 but the sdk returns 10 (default) even when callers pass topK: 5. causing different ranking UIs in prod vs local tests. repro below.

harper: curl (works)
```
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank?top_k=5' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-mini","query":"q","candidates":["a","b","c","d","e"]}'
# -> 200 OK
# -> { "results": [ /* 5 items */ ] }
```

harper: node-sdk (broken)
```
const out = await client.rerank.rank({ model: 'rerank-mini', query: 'q', candidates: ['a','b','c','d','e'], topK: 5 })
// out.results.length -> 10 (server returned default 10)
```

harper: seems like the SDK is serializing topK into the JSON body as `topK` instead of mapping to query param `top_k`, and the server only reads the query param. cc @sam for SDK mapping fix.

sam: good catch. that matches a codegen gap in our param plumbing: query params need explicit mapping in the hand-written wrapper for rerank endpoints. generator emitted body-only fields. quick fix: map both `topK` and `top_k` to the query string. also add deprecation tolerant parsing on server side if possible.

ana: (typo: ana) can we be forgiving in the SDK API? accept topK, top_k, and k for backward compat. add unit tests verifying query string built when any of those provided. also add an integration e2e in the onboarding sampleapp that asserts reranker returns same length as curl.

sam: plan: 1) update node-sdk rerank wrapper to promote topK/top_k/k into query param `top_k` 2) add unit + integration tests, 3) release patch (node-sdk 0.10.4) and call out breaking note that body-only `topK` won't work prior to patch, 4) check telemetry for customers that may have relied on the bug.

harper: customer impact: A/B comparing rerank thresholds looked off; support got a ticket. mark as high priority.

sam: opening PR now, will include test and changelog. tagging @devex-bot.

devex-bot: Created issue #4120: "node-sdk rerank: map topK/top_k/k option to ?top_k query param to align with REST behavior" assigned to sam, priority: high. https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4120 :white_check_mark:

harper: thanks — also let's grep other endpoints for similar query-vs-body param drift (e.g., rerank, search, jobs). might be systemic in codegen templates.

sam: agreed. i'll add a quick audit and post findings in this thread. :mag_right:
